{{Top|leg}}
The '''Outer Court of the Royal Residence''' was a large ballroom inside the [[Royal Residence of Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. All social gatherings and functions where held here by the [[perator]] of [[Cartann]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

It had an arched entryway where all weapons except a [[blastsword]] were confiscated by the guards. The entryway leads to the ballroom which was a two-story chamber with a balcony all around the second story. Its walls were draped with tapestries in a shimmering silver hue.<ref name="soa" />

It was here where the [[Pekaelic ke Teldan|perator of Cartann]] held all his receptions to the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] dignitaries of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was also here where he announced the first world planetary government of Adumar.<ref name="soa" />
